insight: From Nomic AI — makers of the open GPT4All local LLM app and the open-weight nomic-embed models; raised a $17M Series A.
name: Nomic Atlas
tagline: Explore, structure, and analyze millions of unstructured records as interactive embedding maps.
description: Nomic Atlas is a data-intelligence platform that embeds large collections of text, image, and audio data and renders them as interactive 2-D maps you can browse, search, cluster, and label in the browser. Powered by Nomic's own embedding and topic-modeling models, it scales from hundreds to tens of millions of points and exposes the same pipeline through a developer API for embeddings and retrieval.

modelSupport.notes: Uses Nomic's own embedding models (nomic-embed) for mapping and retrieval.

edge: Explore huge embedding datasets as a zoomable map you visually search, cluster, and label in the browser — no notebook required.
pros: Visual maps of huge unstructured datasets
cons: Public free tier exposes maps publicly

references.title: Nomic AI secures $17 million in Series A funding
